module: Telemetry tracker for MCP tool calls (the game's Model Context Protocol server): for each tool call, records the tool name and whether the call failed (event "mcpToolCalled"). Arguments and results are not reported.

onMcpToolCalled.desc: Hook called when an MCP tool is called: emits mcpToolCalled.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook called on load: manual unload.
